method: Leakage-safe Monte Carlo: for each season 2016-2025, the actual playoff field+seeds (derived from real Wild Card pairings) and end-of-regular-season Elo ratings (frozen before playoffs) were fed to backend/app/playoffs/engine.py::simulate_playoff_bracket with DEFAULT adjustments (pure Elo + 35 HFA). 50,000 sims/season, fixed rng seeds. No playoff outcome was used as input.
